readerCopy.body: The urge to reject every rule can become strongest when one particular restriction has been allowed to dominate for too long. When Uranus squares Lilith, disruption and autonomy create friction, making abrupt rebellion look cleaner than the complicated work of changing the exact expectation causing the problem. A rule may deserve to be broken without every surrounding structure needing to collapse with it. The useful distinction is the freedom being sought and the damage produced only by impatience.
